# Bid the run, the corners, and the extras.

> Price a residential crown-molding install from linear feet, corners, paint-grade versus stain-grade, simple cove versus colonial versus built-up, ceiling and height, and extras — plus the walk-away price an $8/ft special cannot see.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
